status: Prospective computational protocol fixed before new simulations and before extracting numerical observational axes; not an external preregistration and not prospective to historical CMB anomaly discovery.
purpose: Independent isotropic directional-null baseline and assessment of recovered records; not a recreation of the historical 100000-PBH simulation.

rng.name: xoshiro128**
rng.seeding: four SplitMix32 words, explicit uint32 arithmetic; source controls exact definition

coordinates.formula: (cos b cos l, cos b sin l, sin b)
coordinates.angles: degrees for input/output, radians in trigonometry

primary.name: quadrupole-octopole maximum-angular-momentum-dispersion alignment
primary.axis_definition: n_l is the eigenvector of the largest eigenvalue of Q_ij=Re[(L_i a)^dagger(L_j a)]
primary.null: statistically isotropic full-sky independent Gaussian multipoles imply independent uniform headless n_l and A23~Uniform(0,1)
primary.uncertainty: 95% Wilson interval for underlying tail probability; Monte Carlo error only

sampling.gaussian_alm: C_l=1; a_l0~N(0,1) real; Re a_lm, Im a_lm~N(0,1/2) independently for m>0; a_l,-m=(-1)^m conjugate(a_lm)
sampling.normal: Box-Muller, cos and sin outputs in fixed order
sampling.units: null coefficients arbitrary dimensionless normalization; axes invariant to each positive C_l scale

multiplicity.statistic: max abs(dot(n_l,n_k)); all axes resampled each realization
multiplicity.report: family tail at primary observed threshold and Bonferroni min(1,36*p); neither reconstructs unknown historical search
multiplicity.free_axis: If reference axis is fitted to same single vector, max |dot(n,r)|=1 for every null draw, hence p=1.

controls.positive: fixed 5 degree separated axes; tests statistic sensitivity only, not physical prediction
controls.pbh: 100000 independent isotropic unit spin directions, 64 fixed sequential RNG realizations; record resultant norm/sqrt(N) and headless cosine to fixed z; no mergers or physical time, masses, units, sky transfer or EFMW equation
controls.diagnostics: bin counts, mean A, exact vs MC tail, harmonic vs uniform-axis null; test rotational invariance and known extreme harmonic coefficients

observation_plan.preferred: published maximum-angular-momentum-dispersion quadrupole/octopole axes or separation from official Planck/WMAP papers, exact method/release cited
observation_plan.fallback: published summary reanalysis only if raw FITS bytes or analysis runtime unavailable; no claim of pixel-map reproduction
observation_plan.variants: report all retrieved compatible component-separation/correction variants; never select minimum p
observation_plan.prohibitions: Do not treat multipole-vector-area normals as angular-momentum axes; do not invent a global p over undocumented statistics or infer vorticity from headless alignment.

interpretation: Statistical anisotropy, a preferred observational axis, and fluid/spacetime vorticity are separate. Gaussian isotropic null differs from all isotropic non-Gaussian models.
stop: Run fixed N once; preserve failed checks and amendments; do not tune seed, estimator, ell range or thresholds to observation.
